tools.name: list_dossiers
tools.description: List every published AB[500] artist dossier (name, slug, subtitle, editions, tier, updated date). Start here to discover which artists have a biography available.

tools.name: search_artists
tools.description: Search AB[500] artist dossiers by name or keyword; returns matching artists with their slugs. Use before get_dossier when you don't know the exact slug.

tools.name: get_dossier
tools.description: Get one artist's full structured biography by slug: subtitle, essay prose (markdown), identity (born/based/practice), works, images, and the verified bibliography with source URLs. Prose is CC0.

tools.name: get_otdh_methodology
tools.description: Get the definition, formulas, full-universe coverage, limitations, discussion URL, and snapshot metadata for AB5D's artist-level Oeuvre Total Days Held metric.

tools.name: list_artist_otdh
tools.description: List the ranked oTDH records for all 308 AB[500] artists, or a limited leading subset. oTDH is a price-independent signal of current uninterrupted collector holding duration.

tools.name: get_artist_otdh
tools.description: Get one artist's oTDH rank, score, collector breadth, raw collector-days, project count, and snapshot metadata by AB5D artist slug.

tools.name: list_artist_collector_tdh
tools.description: List all 308 artist-specific collector TDH dashboard records, including each metric label, route, data URL and verified or pending source status.

tools.name: get_artist_collector_tdh
tools.description: Get one artist-specific collector TDH register by AB5D artist slug. Collector rows are paginated because large Raster-indexed oeuvres can contain thousands of current addresses.

tools.name: list_open_bounties
tools.description: List every AB5D bounty that is currently open for claim, including reward, eligibility, claim route, submission route, protocol, and acceptance command. Only returned tasks are current offers.

tools.name: get_bounty
tools.description: Get one AB5D bounty task by identifier, including its current status and operational routes. Do not begin work unless the returned status is open.
